observations: Photo 0 shows a large, dirty, metallic automotive gearbox or transmission unit lying on a concrete or asphalt surface.
The unit has visible wear, rust, and grime, with some parts showing signs of use or exposure to elements.

A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI NEMZ AUTOSPARE PARTS INV' is visible across the image.

claims.claim: buy fix and drive and enjoy
claims.evidence: This is a subjective statement about functionality and condition; cannot be verified from a single photo.

risks.risk: Internal damage or wear not visible externally (e.g., worn gears, bearings, or hydraulic seals)
risks.proof: A video showing the gearbox being rotated or tested for smooth operation, or a close-up of the internal components if disassembled.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or requiring major repairs

risks.risk: Missing or damaged internal components (e.g., solenoids, sensors, or control unit)
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of the control unit and associated sensors, or a demonstration of the unit's electrical functionality.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly incomplete or requiring additional parts

risks.risk: The gearbox may not be compatible with the buyer's vehicle model or engine
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model number or part number stamped on the gearbox, or a photo of the vehicle it was removed from.

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
A clear photo of the model number or part number stamped on the gearbox.
A video showing the gearbox being rotated or tested for smooth operation.
